`Dockerfile.openshift`|Replaces script-based builder steps with direct `go build` invocations in both OpenShift builder stages.| **Containerlab end-to-end tests** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Suite bootstrap and namespace setup**
`e2e/suite_test.go`|Adds the E2E test entrypoint, NADs flag parsing, and namespace setup/teardown around the suite.| |**Bond mode specs and manifests**
